name: Heavy Leaden Collection Phial
summary: In Kharanos, Ozzie Togglevolt provides the Heavy Leaden Collection Phial for research into decontamination. It is meant to siphon and contain unstable irradiated discharge from mutants deep inside Gnomeregan.

sections.title: A Shielded Vessel
sections.body: The Heavy Leaden Collection Phial draws volatile residue from living, irradiated creatures in Gnomeregan. Keeping the fallout contained is difficult, and a suitable sample may take several attempts to collect.

sections.title: Pursuit of a Cure
sections.body: Ozzie Togglevolt provides the phial to support his research into reversing the horrific mutations afflicting leper gnomes. Earlier samples from surface troggs lacked the potency needed for effective chemical analysis. With the leaden phial, researchers hope to gather samples from virulent beasts such as irradiated slimes and lurkers in the Hall of Gears. They seek the active elements in the city's toxic fallout, then hope to formulate an effective antidote.

faq.q: What is the Heavy Leaden Collection Phial used for?
faq.answer: The phial siphons concentrated radioactive discharge from living irradiated creatures inside Gnomeregan. Researchers in Kharanos use the samples for decontamination trials.

faq.q: Who provides the Heavy Leaden Collection Phial?
faq.answer: Ozzie Togglevolt, a gnome researcher in Kharanos in Dun Morogh, provides the phial for his research into curing irradiated and afflicted leper gnomes.

faq.q: Why is the phial made of heavy lead?
faq.answer: The phial is described as heavy and leaden, but its precise construction is not explained. Ozzie warns that containing the radioactive fallout is difficult and that the sample will collapse quickly.

faq.q: Which creatures must be sampled with the phial?
aliases: what do i use it on
faq.answer: The phial must be used on living, glowing horrors in the depths of Gnomeregan, including irradiated slimes, lurkers, and horrors prowling the lower levels of the Hall of Gears.

angles.text: As a gnome, every drop of volatile fallout secured in the phial is a desperate step toward reclaiming Gnomeregan and understanding the chemical madness that stole your home.
As an engineer, you can use the phial to collect volatile fallout. Even with a suitable vessel, the process may take several attempts.
